about: King George Co., VA, Will Book 3, pp.112-532: AI review of 86 wills against the original abstract text. Each record fully replaces the automatic extraction for the will matched by key [vol, pages, auto_testator] in src/auto_wills.txt. recipients use 'Name (relationship)'; a leading ~ marks an unnamed group. Bequest recipients match a recipients entry, or name enslaved people for FREED/HIRED/CHOICE/SOLD rows. verb is GIVES, LENDS, SOLD, FREED, HIRED or CHOICE.
